caption: Knox v. New Jersey Department of Corrections
citation_line: Knox v. New Jersey Department of Corrections, No. 2:25-cv-01293 (D.N.J. Feb. 2, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Farbiarz dismissed ADA, ADEA, and implied-covenant claims against the New Jersey Department of Corrections on sovereign-immunity grounds but allowed prospective-injunctive-relief claims against an individual supervisor to proceed under Ex parte Young.
qualification_rationale: The opinion cleanly distinguishes state-agency immunity from the officer-suit exception in an employment setting. It meets the doctrinal gate but remains supplemental because it applies established law and has no identified appellate or press significance.
appellate_posture_note: No appellate disposition was identified as of the cutoff.
